actions.action: Merge paragraph versions, not complete documents.
actions.mechanism: Per-paragraph causal histories distinguish sequential edits from concurrent alternatives, including deletion versus editing.
actions.implementation: Attach two-device revision vectors to edits. Merge by stable paragraph ID; retain concurrent text versions or deletion tombstones with authorship.
actions.check: Replay independent edits in both arrival orders; both survive. Concurrent edits retain identical original texts and author/device labels.
actions.risk: Scalar logical revisions alone cannot establish causality.

actions.action: Separate paragraph movement from paragraph text.
actions.mechanism: Independent position metadata lets text edits survive reordering without treating movement as replacement.
actions.implementation: Assign sortable fractional position keys. Concurrent moves of one ID use a deterministic revision/device tie-break; equal positions sort by paragraph ID.
actions.check: Replay opposing moves and simultaneous text edits in both orders; paragraph order converges, IDs remain unique, and edits survive.
actions.risk: Position keys can grow; avoid unsynchronized renumbering.

actions.action: Make conflict resolution explicit and attributable.
actions.mechanism: A resolution supersedes only the alternatives the user reviewed, never an unseen concurrent edit.
actions.implementation: Show original alternatives, authors, devices, and deletion status. Save the user's choice or combined text with referenced version IDs and causal context.
actions.check: Resolve two alternatives, then deliver an unseen concurrent edit; it must reappear as a conflict without overwriting the resolution.
actions.risk: Premature history cleanup can erase explanations or unresolved text.

actions.action: Persist and replay an idempotent edit journal.
actions.mechanism: Durable operations and acknowledged revision ranges support delayed exchange through the existing transport without duplicate application.
actions.implementation: Persist operations before acknowledging local saves; deduplicate by device/revision. Retain unacknowledged history throughout offline periods rather than expiring it at 48 hours.
actions.check: From one snapshot, script independent edits, opposing moves, and deletion versus editing; replay both reconnect orders, duplicates, and crashes. Compare states and conflict originals.
actions.risk: Unbounded edit volume requires storage monitoring; paragraph limits do not bound history.
